params.message:
Ask and the Gentells MCP give a text's sources their Gentells links

A source got a page on gentells.com only when a post or a report cited it. A text
made with an assistant outside both could only link to its publishers. An editor can
now hand over the addresses (at most 60 at a time), keep the pages Gentells does not
hold after seeing them, and get each one's page back. Competitors, sources read for
inspiration and pages of Gentells are refused, also behind a redirect. A title the
assistant gives names only a page that could not be read and never becomes its text.
The guide now says Ask can look on the web.

The site reaches the same tools at POST /internal/desk-tools with its own token,
DESK_TOOLS_TOKEN; unset means closed.

Portal: Bronnen uit een tekst die met Ask of een gekoppelde assistent gemaakt is, kunnen nu een eigen pagina en link op gentells.com krijgen.
